svg.aria-label: The customer owns the agent. The agent registers itself with ThunderID through a self-registration flow and has no access yet. ThunderID asks the customer to approve the agent; the customer approves, consents, and can revoke. The bank's administrators can revoke the agent too. The agent gets a token with the authorization code flow and PKCE, proving itself with private_key_jwt, for the bank as its resource. It calls the bank with a bearer token using the On-Behalf-Of flow: its sub is the owner and its act is the agent. The bank asks ThunderID whether the token is still active.
svg.text: gets a token, proving itself with its own key

g.text: On-Behalf-Of (OBO) flow | sub = owner · act = agent
